name: University of Waterloo

approvals.title: Ontario Ministry of Colleges and Universities

about.text: The University of Waterloo started as Waterloo College Associate Faculties in 1956. It became an independent university in 1959. This came under the University of Waterloo Act. It offers a wide range of courses under six faculties, namely, Arts, Engineering, Environment, Health, Mathematics, and Science. The campus of the university stretches over 1000+ acres with 100+ buildings. Apart from this, the university also has 3 satellite campuses.

University of Waterloo stands apart because it blends 4 things very well. These are strong teaching, real-world learning, an entrepreneurial mindset, and research that creates real impact. This mix makes Waterloo one of the most connected schools in the world. Co-op is Waterloo's biggest strength. 77% of students take part in it. Students switch between classes and paid work. Each stretch runs for four months. Most co-op students graduate with up to two years of paid work experience. No other Canadian school runs a co-op program to this level.

The University of Waterloo provides a high-quality research framework that backs its reputation. It is also home to a Nobel Laureate and other global-level awards and recognitions. It offers full-time on-campus programs as well as 100% online programs. The university is recognized by the top accreditation and approval bodies in Canada and across the world.

aboutBoxes.title: Online Degree Acceptance
aboutBoxes.content: Online degrees earned from a government-approved university, just like a regular degree, are accepted by the top recruiters worldwide including government & private sectors.

aboutBoxes.title: Value of Online Degree
aboutBoxes.content: An online degree from a government-approved university holds similar recognition in the industry as that of a regular degree. Thus, it is equally valuable when considered for a job or higher education.

aboutBoxes.title: Quality of Education
aboutBoxes.content: The quality of education offered in online programs is of the same standard as offered in an on-campus program. Be it curriculum, faculty members, evaluation methods, practical sessions, online & on-campus programs follow similar standards of quality.

facts: The University of Waterloo was established in 1957 in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.
It was started as Waterloo College Associate Faculties.
It became an independent university under the University of Waterloo Act.
The school has six faculties: Arts, Engineering, Environment, Health, Mathematics, and Science.
The University of Waterloo also offers 100% Online courses, such as the Chief Technology and AI Officer Program.
Waterloo runs the biggest co-op program, which is popular globally.
It is also known as Canada's top research university.
The university offers both full-time on-campus programs and 100% online programs.
The university houses students from all over the world, apart from Canada.
The school is part of the U15, a group of Canada's top research universities.

emi.text: The University of Waterloo does not offer an EMI Facility to pay the fees. However, it gives flexibility to pay the fees in every term instead of a one-time annual payment. Apart from this, it offers a wide range of scholarships and financial aid to outperforming students.

admission.text: The University of Waterloo follows a dedicated admission process for its programs. The admission process for most of the courses in this university is online. Here is the admission process-
Step 1: Visit the official website of the University of Waterloo
Step 2: Choose the course/program you are interested in enrolling in.
Step 3: Sign up and generate the login details
Step 4: Enter the login details and sign in.
Step 5: Fill in all the required details in the application form.
Step 7: Submit the IELTS or TOEFL scores. This is required if English is not your first language.
Step 8: Review your application form to ensure that the application is error-free, and pay the application fee to submit the application form.
Step 9: Wait for the admission decision from the university.
Step 10: If accepted, prepare for the adventurous journey at the University of Waterloo.

examination.text: The University of Waterloo follows a comprehensive examination pattern for most of its courses. Undergraduate and graduate students are assessed based on tests, assignments, projects, and end-of-term finals. The assessment of Co-op students is done on the basis of work-term reports and employer evaluations. For doctoral-level courses, candidates are evaluated based on their comprehensive exams, a thesis proposal defence, original research, and a final viva voce.
